limitations: Chromium viewport emulation, not physical mobile/iOS Safari.
Exactly six changed appendices play at 1x on desktop; mobile checks pause in fullscreen without a second playback.
No extra complete MP4 fetch is added by UI QA; all 17 full output SHA checks are covered by local/online verification.
Playback is muted; no human audio/ASR claim. Complete bodies and original code cards use old fingerprint equality.
Screenshot inspection must confirm title/credit readability and absence of card quotes/locators before visual QA passes.
390px embedded video remains small; full reading is inspected in native fullscreen at 844×390.
Research quotations and original links remain in articles. Citation clicks prevent external navigation.
